scenario: AITA for taking home the lasagna? | I made lasagna and brought it over to my boyfriend’s friend’s potluck. She was also really rude when she saw that I brought lasagna. She was telling me that nobody could compete with hers so she won’t put mine out to save me from embarrassment. I never been to a potluck before so I didn’t know and my friend told me that it’s okay. AITA?
